species.name: Honey mushrooms
species.caution: Deadly galerina grows on the same wood, sometimes in the same cluster — honeys print white, galerina rusty brown. Jack-o'-lanterns also cluster on oak. Cook thoroughly; some people react even then.

species.name: Matsutake
species.caution: Deadly white Amanitas (destroying angels) look similar. Check for a sac-like cup at the base, and the matsutake's spicy cinnamon smell.
species.seasonNote: Northeast records shifted 4 weeks later for NJ
